cat's cradle.translation: n. 挑棚子的游戏，翻线戏（二人互翻一线圈使成各种形状的游戏）; 翻绳儿

cat's hair.translation: [医] 洋大戟草, 治喘莠

cat's-claw.translation: n. 【植物】猫爪猴耳环(Pithecellobium unguis-cati)[亦作 catclaw,亦称作 blackbead]

cat's-eye.definition:
n. A variety of quartz or chalcedony, exhibiting opalescent
   reflections from within, like the eye of a cat. The name is given to
   other gems affording like effects, esp. the chrysoberyl.
cat's-eye.translation: n. 猫儿眼, 猫睛石

cat's-eye pupil.translation: [医] 猫眼状瞳孔(瞳孔细长)

cat's-foot.definition:
n. A plant (Nepeta Glechoma) of the same genus with
   catnip; ground ivy.
cat's-foot.translation: n. 欧亚活血丹, 蝶须

cat's-paw.definition: n. a hitch in the middle of rope that has two eyes into which tackle can be hooked

cat's-tail.translation:
n. 【植】问荆
[网络] 猫尾巴西点蛋糕坊
